independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the offset, arrow, the 7u text row, its padding, radius and width cap.

intent: Name or explain a control in a few words while the pointer rests on it or it has keyboard focus

properties.description: Whether the tooltip is shown. Setting it (attribute or property) fires no openchange; hover, focus, a press, Escape or an outside press set it unless openchange is canceled.
Open at first connect when no open attribute is present (Base UI defaultOpen).
Never opens; presses, hover and focus on the trigger do nothing.

Preferred side of the trigger (Base UI Positioner side): top, bottom, left or right; empty for the default (top). The popup flips to the opposite side when there is no room; data-side says where it is.
Alignment along that side (Base UI Positioner align): start, center or end; empty for the default (center).
Open after the pointer rests this long on the trigger, in ms (Base UI delay); default 600. Keyboard focus and a warm group open it at once.
Close this long after the pointer leaves trigger and popup, in ms (Base UI closeDelay); default 0 (at least one frame, so the pointer can cross onto the popup).
The popup's text in the preset form (kept in sync); ignored when a [data-part=popup] is authored.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

events.name: openchange
events.trigger: hover, keyboard focus, blur, a press on the trigger, an outside press or Escape opens or closes the tooltip; preventDefault keeps it as it is

semantics.role: none on the host; the popup is role=tooltip and the trigger's aria-describedby names it (after any description the trigger already has)

keyboard.action: hide it; focus stays on the trigger

sources: the trigger names itself (text or aria-label); the tooltip describes it

content.children: One trigger element (the first child element), or authored [data-part=trigger] and [data-part=popup] children; a [data-part=arrow] in the popup draws the arrow.

constraints: Text only: the popup is not focusable and its content is never interactive (use a popover for interactive content).
The host takes no box (display: contents): the trigger lays out where the host is written.
Touch has no hover: a tooltip opens from keyboard focus or hover only, so the trigger must be understandable without it.
Setting open from script shows or hides the popup without an openchange event.

avoidWhen.when: Content the user acts on (links, buttons, inputs).
avoidWhen.reason: A tooltip disappears when the pointer leaves and takes no focus; a popover holds interactive content.

avoidWhen.when: A preview of a linked page or profile.
avoidWhen.reason: A preview card is the richer hover card for links.

avoidWhen.when: Text the user needs in order to complete a task.
avoidWhen.reason: Hidden text is easy to miss and unavailable on touch; put it in a field description.

nodes.summary: The described control (the first child element, any focusable element; a plain one becomes role=button): aria-describedby names the popup, data-popup-open while open. Base UI Tooltip.Trigger.
The floating layer (popover=manual, in the top layer while open), 1u from the trigger, above it by default. Base UI Tooltip.Positioner.
The text (role=tooltip): a 7u row on the inverse fill; data-instant when the warm group skipped the motion. Base UI Tooltip.Popup.
Optional triangle on the popup's edge facing the trigger, centered on it. Base UI Tooltip.Arrow.
